title: Returns & Exchanges Refund Settlement Rules
content:
These rules govern how a Returns & Exchanges return is settled: what it may never take back, when a refund may be paid, where the money goes, and what settling triggers. What Marlowe & Finch still owes on a return is the accepted value credited, less the fees withheld and the refunds paid; it is negative while an instant store credit has been paid ahead of inspection.

## Value credited

1. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause defining the value credited for each line as the net unit price paid — the booked unit price less its allocated promotion discount, less any price adjustment or late promotion credited on that line — times the accepted units, has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
2. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause adding the sales tax on those units as the order's sales tax times the line's refunded net merchandise divided by the order's net merchandise, rounded half up to the cent per line, has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
3. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause adding the original shipping fee and surcharge only where the return type refunds original shipping has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
4. Returning units never claws back a promotion beyond the discount already allocated to the returned line, and never re-charges a shipping fee that a free-shipping threshold had waived.

## When a refund may be paid

5. A final-settlement refund is issued only once the return is in status inspected; the instant store credit alone is issued earlier, when the return is in status in transit at its first carrier scan.

| Return status | Final-settlement refund | Instant store credit |
|---|---|---|
| In transit (at the first carrier scan) | No | Yes |
| Inspected | Yes | — |
| Authorized, received, settled, cancelled, expired | No | No |

## Where the money goes

6. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause stating that the amount paid is what is owed on the return after fees has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
7. A return settled to the original tenders pays the tenders captured on the order in the Online Orders tender refund priority, each up to what remains refundable on it: the amount captured on that tender for the order less the amounts already refunded to it by order refunds and by final-settlement return refunds of the order. A stored-value instrument is refunded to itself under the Gift Cards & Store Credit rules.
8. A return settled in Return Store Credit pays one new Return Store Credit to the returning customer.
9. Only one refund is paid per refund stage and tender instrument.

## What settling triggers

10. Settling the return reverses the Marlowe Rewards points earned on the refunded merchandise.
11. A return is settled within the settlement standard of 2 business days of inspection.

## Points of judgement

- A customer asking for the refund before the parcel has been inspected: no final-settlement refund can be paid while the return is not in status inspected.
- A second final-settlement refund to the same card on the same return: not paid, since one refund per stage and tender instrument is the limit.
- Example (hypothetical): an order captured 60.00 USD on a card and 40.00 USD on a gift card, with 50.00 USD already refunded to the card by an earlier order refund; on a return settled to the original tenders, the card can take at most 10.00 USD more, and the gift card is refunded to itself.

superseded_clauses: plus the sales tax on those units (`refund_includes_sales_tax`), which is the order's sales tax times the line's refunded net merchandise divided by the order's net merchandise (`tax_refund_basis`), rounded half up to the cent per line (`refund_rounding_rule`)

For each line, the value credited is the net unit price paid — the booked unit price less its allocated promotion discount, less any price adjustment or late promotion credited on that line — times the accepted units
The amount paid is returns_msr_refund_due after fees.
